docsDescription: Run Shorts yourself, deploy it to your infrastructure, or integrate short links from scripts and external services.
authenticationDescription: Create a key from the API keys page and send it in the x-api-key header. The full key is shown only once.
createDescription: Send at least a URL. Slug, title, and expiry are optional. Add clickLimit to switch the link off once it is reached, or password to gate it behind a form.
updateDescription: Send only the fields you want to change. Set active to false to stop redirecting, or adFree to true to skip the advertising interstitial for one link.
errorsDescription: Errors use the appropriate HTTP status and a JSON body with message. Check URL and slug for 400 errors, the key for 401, and resource existence for 404.
advertisingDescription: Configure AdsTerra banners, a visible-only countdown, and whether its end reveals Continue to site or redirects automatically. Paste an invoke.js URL or the complete copied snippet; each banner size can be used once.
selfHostDescription: Start the full stack locally, then move the same repository to your production infrastructure.
localSetupDescription: Use Bun with PostgreSQL and Redis you can reach from your machine.
productionDeployDescription: Use the platform-specific Docker Compose configuration included with the repository.
deploymentRequirements: Use one HTTPS domain, keep your secrets stable, and choose managed or bundled PostgreSQL and Redis.
